concerns.concern: The DFT model uses a commensurate 1×1 Si2Te2/HfTe2 cell, which forces HfTe2 to about 389 pm instead of its real ~397 pm lattice. The 'strain-free' result is therefore partly built into the setup, and the substrate bands, band offset, work function and binding energy are computed for an artificially compressed substrate. The measured HfTe2 lattice and an incommensurate or strained model are missing.
concerns.quote: This forces both layers to a common lattice constant, so the 'strain-free' DFT result is partly built into the setup.

concerns.concern: The edge-state evidence is a single peak at EF, which sits only about 10 meV above the valence-band maximum, so it lies at the gap edge rather than inside the gap. Spectra cover only ±100 mV, so the 100–290 meV range where a helical edge channel should give enhanced LDOS is never examined. The data are also consistent with a trivial edge resonance.
concerns.quote: the edge spectra (Fig. 5b,c) are recorded only from −100 to +100 mV, so the range 100–290 meV... is never examined

concerns.concern: The 2–3 nm spatial extent of the edge feature does not exclude other trivial explanations. These include band bending at the island edge, trivial Tamm/Shockley-like edge bands of a reconstructed edge, and enhancement of the substrate-induced states already visible in the center spectra.
concerns.quote: Band bending, substrate-derived states, and setpoint/topography artifacts in the edge maps are not excluded.

concerns.concern: The heterostructure is metallic because HfTe2 bands cross the Si2Te2 gap. A Wannier-charge-centre Z2 calculation needs an isolated band set, yet the bands used are not stated. Momentum-integrated STS also cannot isolate a 'gap at Γ', and the edge states may hybridize with the substrate continuum.
concerns.quote: It is not stated which band set was used or how the substrate bands were handled.

concerns.concern: Claiming 'experimental realization of the QSH phase' is an overclaim. No spin-resolved, quasiparticle-interference/dispersion or transport evidence is presented to show helical, quantized edge channels.
concerns.quote: 'Realization of the QSH phase' is therefore an overclaim relative to what STS can establish.

concerns.concern: Three statements about the Fermi level are not reconciled. DFT puts EF below the Si2Te2 VBM (hole-doped), STS puts the VBM at −10 meV, and an unexplained 0.25 eV rigid shift is attributed to substrate doping even though the substrate is explicitly modelled.
concerns.quote: DFT puts EF below the Si2Te2 VBM; experiment puts the VBM at −10 meV; an unexplained 0.25 eV rigid shift is also invoked.

concerns.concern: The edge dI/dV map is taken with a 0.2 V constant-current setpoint across a 7 Å step. Such setpoint effects are known to create rim-like contrast, so the edge contrast may be an artifact.
concerns.quote: Constant-current setpoint effects near step edges are known to generate rim-like contrast in dI/dV maps.

concerns.concern: The bulk gap is described inconsistently across figures: −100 to 300 meV, −10 to 290 meV, a ±50 mV dip and a ±10 mV minimum. Readers cannot tell which feature is the bulk gap and which is a zero-bias substrate or tip feature.
concerns.quote: Readers cannot tell which feature is the bulk gap and which is a substrate- or tip-related zero-bias feature.

concerns.concern: The screening mismatch parameter is defined with the opposite sign to the strain tolerance, so the stated window appears inverted. PtSe2 also seems to fall outside the stated window.
concerns.quote: Broadening −3%…2% by 0.5% should then give −2.5% < Δ < 3.5%, not −3.5% < Δ < 2.5%.

concerns.concern: It is unclear whether bulk or C2DB monolayer lattice constants were used in the substrate screening.
concerns.quote: It is also unclear whether bulk or C2DB monolayer lattice constants were used.

concerns.concern: The measured edge-state width (about 2–3 nm) is 50–120% larger than the DFT value of 1.35 nm, yet it is called good agreement. The width definition, the effects of tip and sampling convolution, and possible edge–edge coupling in the nanoribbon model are not addressed.
concerns.quote: The agreement is at best qualitative.

concerns.concern: The text says the lattice-mismatch filter yields 76 candidates, but Fig. 1(a) shows 65.
concerns.quote: The text states that the lattice-mismatch filter yields 76 candidates, but the funnel in Fig. 1(a) shows 65 TMDs

concerns.concern: The measured step height of 710 pm differs from the calculated 790 pm by about 10%. No bias dependence or estimate of the electronic contribution is given to explain the difference.
concerns.quote: no bias dependence or estimate of the electronic contribution is offered.

concerns.concern: The growth and annealing recipe is underspecified, which prevents reproduction. Missing are the flux rates, Si:Te ratio, anneal duration and ramp rate, and coverage. The apparent conflict between decomposition above 320 °C and crystallization at 385 °C is also unexplained.
concerns.quote: the main text does not let readers reproduce the result.

concerns.concern: Ref. 39 is not the standard citation for the Wannier-charge-centre Z2 method. Soluyanov & Vanderbilt or Yu et al. should be cited instead.
concerns.quote: Ref. 39 (Giustino & Pasquarello...) is not the standard source for the WCC Z2 method.

concerns.concern: The description of the supplemental material in Ref. 35, which mentions three stripe orientations, does not match anything in the paper.
concerns.quote: 'large area scans showing the coexistence of three stripe orientations', which does not match anything in this paper.
